WhatsApp calls ring on their own. To hear it there too, open the chat in WhatsApp, then Notifications, then Call ringtone, and pick it from the Cucuto ringtones.

Android plays a contact's own ringtone when they phone you. To use your characters there, Cucuto needs the contacts permission:

• It reads contacts only to find the person behind a chat.
• It changes only the ringtone of contacts you link, and gives them their old one back when you stop.
• Your contacts never leave your phone.

Cucuto is open source: you (or your AI assistant) can read exactly what it does at github.com/mauriciabad/cucuto.

For “Random per call”, Cucuto picks the next version as soon as a call ends. Android tells it through the phone permission. Cucuto never reads who called, and it is only woken after calls while some contact uses this rule.
Without the contacts permission, Cucuto can\'t set phone ringtones. You can allow it in Android\'s settings for Cucuto.
On: linked contacts ring with their character.
Off: Android\'s ringtones stay as they are.
Link a contact in its chat\'s detail screen. Turning this off gives every contact its old ringtone back.
Every contact gets back the ringtone it had before Cucuto, and Cucuto\'s ringtone files are deleted. Your choices are kept for next time.
